list: Official 55-trophy list as published on PlayStation (via Exophase and PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026): 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden. No online trophies.
note: Names and descriptions are the official PlayStation text. Every guide below is written in my own words for this entry; the sources named beside each guide are where the facts come from. Where no reliable method was known on launch day, the guide says so plainly instead of inventing steps.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. There is nothing extra to do for it: work through the roadmap below, finish the story, clear the 100% checklist, and this is the last trophy you will hear. PowerPyx puts the whole run at about 200 hours and rates it 4/10.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies.
The platinum unlocks on its own as soon as the last one pops.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Play the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1 and see it through to the end; the trophy pops when the mission completes. It is one of the first missions of the game, so there is nothing to prepare for.
steps: Start the story and play through Gone Fishing.
Finish the mission; the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish every main mission of Chapter 1. Before you leave the chapter, do the one thing in the game that may be missable: after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia at Jason's house in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept when she offers to meditate. That session is the only meditation that disappears once Chapter 1 ends, and it may be needed for Positive Mental Attitude.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 1's main missions.
After Down to Earth, meditate with Lucia at Jason's house before the chapter ends.
The trophy pops when Chapter 1 closes.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish every main mission of Chapter 2. From this chapter on, Jason and Lucia are both playable together, which opens up the partner trophies and most of the side content, so take the optional missions as they appear rather than rushing past them.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 2's main missions.
The trophy pops when Chapter 2 closes.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish every main mission of Chapter 3. The chapter includes the mission behind Break the Bank, and by now the robbery side content (bank vaults, armored trucks, illegal operations) is opening up, so it is a good time to start the crime trophies alongside the story.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 3's main missions.
The trophy pops when Chapter 3 closes.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish every main mission of Chapter 4. This is the chapter where the big bank-vault robberies open up (an optional Chapter 4 mission unlocks them), which feeds directly into Maximum Withdrawal, so keep a fast bike handy whenever you go after a vault.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 4's main missions.
The trophy pops when Chapter 4 closes.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable, and the gold that closes the story. Finish the final mission of Chapter 5. Keep a manual save from just before it: there is no mission replay in GTA 6, and a save at the start of each chapter is the only way back if you want to redo anything. After the credits you return to free roam, so nothing else is locked behind the ending.
steps: Make a manual save before the final mission.
Complete the final mission.
The trophy pops at the end of the story; free roam opens afterwards.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. It comes up naturally as you play the chapter; there is no side requirement and no way to skip past it.
steps: Reach and play Breakfast Run in Chapter 2.
Finish the mission.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist. It is a main-mission beat, so it arrives on its own as you work through Chapter 3; just play the story and it pops.
steps: Reach and play The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3.
Finish the mission.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play. Like the other mission trophies, it is tied to the main path and cannot be skipped or missed.
steps: Reach and play Child's Play in Chapter 4.
Finish the mission.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the Chapter 4 mission Headliners. It is part of the main story, so it unlocks as you play through Chapter 4 in order.
steps: Reach and play Headliners in Chapter 4.
Finish the mission.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown, set at Vice City International Airport. It is a main-mission beat; play Chapter 4 through and it pops on completion.
steps: Reach and play VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4.
Finish the mission.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory. It is the last of the named-mission story trophies and arrives late in the story, so keep playing the main path and it will come to you.
steps: Reach and play Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5.
Finish the mission.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set, and the gold that gates the platinum. Reach 100% on the game's own checklist, which appears after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. It has 35 requirements in three groups (story and tasks, exploration and activities, discovery), but the targets are lenient: most ask for only part of a set, such as 300 of the 397 stunts, 200 of the 277 vehicles, 100 of the 255 animals, 50 of the 66 weapons, 70 of the 80 challenges and 15 of the 18 card sets. The few that demand everything are the robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Progress made during the story already counts, and PowerPyx and GTABase both say nothing on the checklist is missable: everything can still be finished in free roam after the credits.
steps: Finish the story; the checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Work through its 35 requirements; partial sets count (for example 300 of 397 stunts).
Clear the full-requirement items last: all robberies, all 42 shooting-range golds, all drone races, all of Bret's quests.

sources.name: The Gamers Hub — GTA 6 100% Completion Checklist

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts scattered around Leonida. There are four kinds: 130 stunt jumps over ramps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250 and this silver will pop on the way. Stunts are tracked in the Progress menu, and a plane or fast bike makes the flying ones far easier.
steps: Find stunt markers around Leonida; ramps and bridges are the easiest to start with.
Complete 250 stunts of any kind.
Keep going to 300 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of activity in the game at least once. The activities include fishing, hunting, bowling, arcade games, shooting ranges, drone races, races and meditation, among others. You only need to try each one, not win or finish it, so work through the activity list early and tick each type off as you sample it. The exact activity list was still being pinned down by guide sites on launch day, so use the in-game activities menu as the checklist and try anything you have not tried yet.
steps: Open the activities available in Leonida and try one of each type.
You only need to attempt each type once, not win it.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. Every challenge at every range has to be golded, and the 100% checklist demands the same 42, so this is one of the few all-or-nothing grinds. The challenges are not rated hard by PowerPyx; take them one weapon at a time, learn each range's target pattern, and retry the ones you miss — there is no penalty for failing and retrying.
steps: Visit each of the 12 shooting ranges.
Earn gold in all 42 challenges.
Track progress under Progress; retry any challenge until it is gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough for the trophy; the 100% checklist wants all 42 races, so the trophy is the easy half of the job. Drone races are short and repeatable, so if you lose one, restart it right away and learn the course line before chasing the win.
steps: Find the Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations.
Win at least one race at every location.
All 42 races are needed for 100% completion.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 available. Winning the same race twice does not count, so you need 20 distinct wins. Pick the vehicle class you are strongest in, learn each course's corners, and keep a note of which races you have already won so you do not waste time repeating them.
steps: Enter races around Leonida.
Win 20 different races; repeats of a race you already won do not count.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal texts you after a Chapter 1 mission and marks the fishing spot with a purple icon on the map. Go to the marked spot, take the challenge and out-fish him. Fishing is one of the activity types, so this also counts toward trying the activities for Master of None.
steps: Wait for Cal's text after a Chapter 1 mission; it marks a purple icon on the map.
Go to the marked fishing spot and take the challenge.
Beat Cal's catch to win.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. Find an arcade machine in Leonida, start a game and play it through to the end. You do not need a high score or a perfect run — finishing one game is enough — and it also counts as trying an activity type for Master of None.
steps: Find an arcade machine.
Play and complete any one arcade game.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand and complete his final mission. Andy is one of the side characters with a multi-mission quest line; his jobs stay open after the story, so you can finish them in free roam. Note that Andy's strand does not count toward the 8 strands needed for Strangers & Freaks, so treat it as its own trophy.
steps: Find Andy's missions and work through his strand.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand and complete his final mission. Kenton is a side character with his own quest line; like the other character strands, it stays available after the story, so there is no deadline — just work through his missions in order until the last one is done.
steps: Find Kenton's missions and work through his strand.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand and complete his final mission. His five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after a Chapter 2 mission, and they stay open after the story, so you can do them whenever you like. Billy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, so finish it for its own trophy.
steps: Go to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after the Chapter 2 mission that unlocks it.
Complete all five of Billy's jobs, ending with his final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands. Not every stranger counts: the strands that count include Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete, while the character quests for Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy do not count toward this silver — those have their own trophies. Strangers & Freaks is not needed for the 100% checklist, so save it for the cleanup stage and work through the counting strangers one by one.
steps: Find stranger missions across Leonida (look for the stranger markers).
Complete 8 full strands that count — Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed counters.
Do not rely on Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy or Billy strands; they have their own trophies and do not count here.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand and complete his final mission. Randy is a side character with a multi-mission quest line that stays open after the story, so work through his jobs in order in free roam until the last one is done.
steps: Find Randy's missions and work through his strand.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand and complete his final mission. Tyrone is a side character with his own quest line, available after the story in free roam. His strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, so finish it for this trophy alone.
steps: Find Tyrone's missions and work through his strand.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY. Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations in Leonida. The danger is the first one: after the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, Lucia talks about meditating at Jason's house in the morning and walks out to the balcony — follow her and accept. That session becomes permanently unavailable after Chapter 1, and it is not yet confirmed whether the trophy needs it, so do it to be safe. The other spots are spread across the map — a sandbar west of Capri, Buckskin Swamp in Kelly County, a water wheel near the paper mill in Moreau, a waterfall in Lummox County, and the final one at the summit of Mount Kalaga, which only appears on the map after the previous spots are done. You can meditate as both Jason and Lucia at a spot, which counts twice toward the meditation counter. Track your count under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. The 100% checklist only asks for 15 of the 18, so this trophy needs more than 100% does.
steps: CHAPTER 1 — DO THIS FIRST: after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia at Jason's house, follow her to the balcony and accept the meditation.
Visit the remaining 17 spots (10 locations); meditate as both Jason and Lucia where you can.
The final spot is at the summit of Mount Kalaga and only appears after the others.
Check Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations until all 18 are done.

sources.name: Beebom — All GTA 6 Meditation Spots Locations

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. His hunting quests start after Chapter 2 and are Jason-only, so switch to Jason before you go looking. The exact animal was not confirmed by the guide sites on launch day, so follow Bret's quest markers and hunt the animal the quest names when you get there. Bret's quests are also one of the few things the 100% checklist demands in full, so do all of them, not just this one.
steps: After Chapter 2, pick up Bret's hunting quests as Jason.
Hunt the unique animal the quest names.
Finish all of Bret's quests too — the 100% checklist needs all of them.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets out of the 18 in the game. There are 480 cards in total, and the 100% checklist wants 15 of the 18 sets, so the three sets for this silver are just the start — keep collecting and you will pass this trophy long before you finish the checklist. Cards are found all over Leonida, so pick up every card you pass while doing other things.
steps: Collect cards as you explore Leonida.
Complete any 3 full sets.
The 100% checklist needs 15 of the 18 sets, so keep collecting.

sources.name: The Gamers Hub — GTA 6 100% Completion Checklist

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 locations. Any mix counts: 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and No Flusher tags all add to the total. WAiNK It is the game's photo-tagging collectible, so snap everything the game lets you tag as you travel — the count builds up naturally if you tag landmarks and curiosities whenever you pass one.
steps: Open the WAiNK It feature at a landmark, curiosity, sculpture or tag spot.
WAiNK It at 100 locations in total, in any mix of categories.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges in the game. The 100% checklist wants 70, so this bronze pops two-thirds of the way there. Challenges cover combat, driving, exploration and more, and they tick off in the background as you play, so check the challenge list in the Progress menu and chase the easy ones first — you are allowed to skip the hardest 10 for 100%, and even more for this trophy.
steps: Check the challenge list under Progress.
Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges.
70 of 80 are needed for 100% completion.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build up a 4-star wanted level and then lose it and escape. You need both protagonists together for this one, which is possible from Chapter 2 onward. Cause enough trouble to reach 4 stars, then break line of sight, get out of the search area and stay hidden until the stars clear — a fast car and the countryside help more than the city streets.
steps: Play with your partner alongside you (both protagonists, from Chapter 2).
Raise your wanted level to 4 stars.
Escape and lose the wanted level completely.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level — meaning you must keep the heat on you the whole time, never dropping to zero stars between robberies. Plan a route of three close-together shops, rob each quickly, and move straight to the next before the police lose you. If the wanted level clears, the chain breaks and you start over.
steps: Bring your partner and pick three shops close together.
Rob the first shop to get a wanted level.
Rob the second and third shops back-to-back before the wanted level clears.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them. The game has 277 base-model vehicles, and the 100% checklist wants 200 of them, so this bronze is the halfway mark. Scan every new vehicle you see while driving around — traffic, parked cars, anything you have not scanned yet — and the count climbs on its own. Make scanning a habit during the story so you are not grinding it at the end.
steps: Scan vehicles you have not discovered yet.
Discover 100 vehicles.
200 of 277 are needed for 100% completion.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Fill your Focus meter first, then find a spot with at least five enemies close together — a gang shootout or a police standoff works — activate Combat Focus with an assault rifle and drop five of them before the meter runs out. If you only get four, let the meter refill and try again.
steps: Fill your Combat Focus meter.
Find five or more enemies grouped together.
Activate Combat Focus with an assault rifle and take down 5 enemies before it ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a passenger jet at Vice City International Airport and take off with it. It has to be a large jet parked at a boarding gate — the planes sitting out on the airfield do not count — and gates E3 and E4 are the easiest to reach. Taxi out and get airborne, then fly about a kilometre away from the airport; expect a 4-star wanted level the moment you move. A few seconds in the air is enough for some players, but flying clear of the airport is the safe version.
steps: Go to VCIA and find a large passenger jet at a boarding gate (E3 or E4 are easiest).
Board it, taxi out and take off.
Fly about 1 km away from the airport.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station and take out enemies from inside it. Get into the tank, then use its cannon on the soldiers or police who come after you — the trophy is about fighting from inside the Rhino, not just sitting in it. Expect heavy resistance, so keep moving and use the tank's armor.
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station and steal a Rhino tank.
Take out enemies from inside the tank.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at any point. The quiet way in is the back door with the Snap Gun, which you get from Yasmani's Chapter 3 jobs — so do those jobs first, then pick a jewelry store, slip in through the back, take the goods and leave without tripping an alarm or being spotted. If anyone sees you, it fails, so go in quiet and leave before the police arrive.
steps: Do Yasmani's Chapter 3 jobs to get the Snap Gun.
Pick a jewelry store and enter through the back door.
Rob it and leave without being detected.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape, out of the 8 vaults in the game. Vaults open up with an optional Chapter 4 mission, and every vault job brings a 4-star wanted level, so have a fast bike ready for the getaway before you go in. The 100% checklist wants all 8 vaults, so keep robbing past five and this silver will pop on the way to 100%.
steps: Unlock vaults with the optional Chapter 4 mission.
Rob a bank vault and escape with a fast getaway vehicle ready.
Repeat for 5 vaults (8 for 100% completion).

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Find a truck on the road, stop it — ramming it or blocking it works — take the cash from the back and get away from the police. A bank vault job can also count toward this one if you escape, so you may pop it while working on Maximum Withdrawal without even trying.
steps: Find an armored truck on the road.
Stop it, take the cash and escape the police.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida: clear the fog from the whole map. Every area you have not visited stays fogged, so the job is to drive, fly or sail everywhere — all 52 areas. A plane is the fastest way to sweep the map, since you can cover the coast, the swamps and the Keys in a few passes. Check the map for fogged patches and mop them up one region at a time.
steps: Travel across Leonida to clear the map fog.
Use a plane to sweep large areas quickly.
Check the map for remaining fogged areas until the whole state is revealed.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs in Leonida. There are 39 operations in total, and the 100% checklist wants all of them, so this trophy is the first ninth of a much bigger job. Hit one operation per gang for the trophy, then keep going through the rest for 100%.
steps: Find illegal operations around Leonida.
Rob one operation from each of the 9 gangs.
All 39 operations are needed for 100% completion.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: The official description is the only solid clue: enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact trigger was not confirmed by PowerPyx or GTABase on launch day, so no guide can yet say which bar, which drink or which moment pops it. The honest read is to go to Ocean Beach, find a bar with a view of the water, order a cocktail and enjoy it there. If it does not pop, try another beachfront spot. I will not invent a specific location: this entry will be updated when players pin the trigger down.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach.
Find a beachfront bar and order a cocktail.
Exact trigger unconfirmed on launch day — see the guide.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The description points to driving a car out through a vehicle showroom's window in classic GTA style. The exact trigger was not confirmed by PowerPyx or GTABase on launch day: no guide has yet pinned down which showroom or which car. The sensible attempt is to take a car inside a vehicle showroom and smash it out through the front glass. If it does not pop, try a different showroom. This entry does not invent a location for it.
steps: Find a vehicle showroom.
Drive a car out through the showroom window.
Exact trigger unconfirmed on launch day — see the guide.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Rob the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn — that is the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — and then lose the police. The trophy is a robbery with a getaway, not a game of bowling: hit the operation, grab what you can and break away from the wanted level to pop it. It also counts toward the illegal operations for Pest Control.
steps: Go to the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn.
Rob the operation.
Lose the police afterwards.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia. Working out together trains both of them at once, so hit the gym with your partner and keep training until both Strength bars are full. It is a grind rather than a skill test: steady gym sessions across the playthrough will get both of them to the top.
steps: Work out at the gym to raise Strength.
Train with your partner so both Jason and Lucia gain Strength.
Max out Strength for both characters.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. The profile tracks the choices you make as you play — lawful or criminal — and the counter climbs as you act. It pops after 500 profile-changing actions, which will take most of a full playthrough to reach. One warning from the guides: do not push your profile all the way to Irredeemable, because that profile state is permanent. Play normally, make choices, and let the counter build up.
steps: Play through the game making choices that change your Criminal Profile.
Reach 500 profile-changing actions.
Do not push your profile to Irredeemable — it is permanent.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The description hints at succeeding on a second attempt — 'second time's the charm' — but the exact trigger was not confirmed by PowerPyx or GTABase on launch day. No reliable guide has yet said which activity, race or mission it belongs to. It may pop naturally while you retry things during the platinum run, so do not chase it blindly: play through, retry what you fail, and check back when players have cracked the trigger. This entry will not invent one.
steps: Exact trigger unconfirmed on launch day — see the guide.
Retry failed activities and races as you play; it may pop on a second attempt.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The description is a reaction — 'what the hell just happened?' — which points to witnessing something strange or unexplained in Leonida. The exact trigger was not confirmed by PowerPyx or GTABase on launch day, so no guide can yet say what event or place pops it. Explore the map, keep an eye out for odd encounters, and expect this one to be cracked by players in the first weeks. This entry will not invent a location for it.
steps: Exact trigger unconfirmed on launch day — see the guide.
Explore Leonida and watch for strange events or encounters.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a melee drive-by. The exact trigger was not confirmed by PowerPyx or GTABase on launch day, so the details (which weapon, how many targets, whether it must be a pedestrian) are still unpinned. The plain reading of the description is: drive past someone and hit them with a melee weapon from the car. Try it on a quiet road with a baseball bat or similar and see if it pops.
steps: Get a melee weapon and a vehicle.
Drive past a pedestrian and strike them with the melee weapon from the moving vehicle.
Exact trigger unconfirmed on launch day — see the guide.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. It is a running total, so every bill you fence adds up — you do not need $250,000 at once. Marked Bills come from banks and payday loan stores, and Yasmani pays the most for them, so fence through him whenever you can. This also counts toward the 100% checklist, which wants the same $250,000 fenced.
steps: Collect Marked Bills from banks and payday loan stores.
Launder them through your contacts; Yasmani pays the most.
Reach $250,000 fenced in total.

sources.name: The Gamers Hub — GTA 6 100% Completion Checklist

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops as a running total. Every purchase counts — clothes, weapons, ammo, food, anything bought in any shop — so it builds up naturally over a full playthrough. If you reach the endgame short of the total, the fastest way to close the gap is to buy expensive weapons and ammo. You will be spending heavily anyway on the garage properties for Little Boxes.
steps: Buy things in shops as you play; every shop purchase counts.
Reach $100,000 spent in total across all shops.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties that are for sale, for about $160,000 in total. The 4 garages you get through the story do not count — only the 8 you buy yourself. Garages are also useful for the Scooter Bros registrations in On the Spot, since you need free garage space to register vehicles, so buy the garages before you chase that trophy.
steps: Find the 8 garage properties for sale around Leonida.
Buy all 8 (about $160,000 in total).
Story garages do not count toward this trophy.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Moses gives you the app in Chapter 2, and you need free garage space to register a vehicle, so buy garage properties first (see Little Boxes) if you are full. Register any 10 vehicles you own or find; each registration counts once, so ten different vehicles will do it.
steps: Get the Scooter Bros app from Moses in Chapter 2.
Make sure you have free garage space.
Register 10 different vehicles to the app.

roadmap.title: Stage 1 — Play the story (Chapters 1–5)
roadmap.text: Play all five chapters in order and take the optional missions as they appear. Scan vehicles and study animals as you go — the 100% checklist wants 200 of 277 vehicles and 100 of 255 animals, and progress made now already counts. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter: there is no mission replay. The one thing you must not skip: in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, meditate with Lucia at Jason's house before the chapter ends — it is the only possibly missable trophy in the game (Positive Mental Attitude). Story trophies in this stage: the 5 chapter trophies, the 6 named-mission trophies and the final-mission gold.

roadmap.title: Stage 2 — Side quests, strangers and partner trophies
roadmap.text: After the story — or alongside it, as the quests appear — finish the side-character strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone), hunt Bret's unique animal as Jason, and complete 8 Strangers & Freaks strands that count (Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete do; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy do not). Do the partner trophies while both protagonists are available: lose a 4-star wanted level together, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing the heat, and max out Strength for both. Try each activity type once for Master of None.

roadmap.title: Stage 3 — Post-story: the 100% checklist grind
roadmap.text: After the credits the 100% checklist appears under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. It has 35 requirements, but most ask for only part of a set: 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 card sets, 15 of 18 meditations, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 50 of 66 weapons. The ones that demand everything are the robberies (22 banks, 7 payday loan stores, 35 Smash 'N' Grabs, 8 vaults), all 39 illegal operations, all 42 shooting-range golds, all 42 drone races and all of Bret's quests. Nothing on the checklist is missable. Finishing it earns the gold A Long Road.

roadmap.title: Stage 4 — Cleanup and the platinum
roadmap.text: Mop up whatever is left: the cryptic one-off trophies (In The Beginning…, Capital Offense, Bad Luck I Guess, The Truth Is Out There, Ten Pin), the 500 Criminal Profile actions for Actions Speak Louder, and any collectibles still short (cards, WAiNK locations, vehicles). When the last of the other 54 pops, the platinum Vice Got a Price! unlocks on its own. Total: about 200 hours, difficulty 4/10 (PowerPyx).

facts.missable: Potentially 1 — Positive Mental Attitude (first meditation in Chapter 1)
